system.description:
Acquired with CR11 or higher. During this Main Process, you gain a +[SRx4] bonus to [Weapon Attack] damage rolls.

(CR17): Increase the bonus to +[SRx5].
(CR23): Increase the bonus to +[SRx7].

A skill that raises the power of subsequent attacks by swinging the weapon around. Accumulated experience turns a mere preliminary movement into a deadly strategy.
